# Bisu Ghalan

> Computer science student and security researcher based in Bhaktapur, Nepal. Builds Telegram bots, command-line tools, and full-stack web apps in Python, Go, Rust, and TypeScript, and studies network infrastructure and defensive security.

Site: https://bisu.com.np
Language: English

- [Experience](https://bisu.com.np/experience): freelance work and hackathon participation.
- [Education](https://bisu.com.np/education): Bachelor of Computer Science in Cyber Security & Network Technology (Hons), Lincoln International College, Kathmandu, batch of September 2025; Higher Secondary Education (+2 Management), Janapremi World School, Bhaktapur, 2024.
- [Tech Stack](https://bisu.com.np/tech-stack): languages, frameworks, databases, AI tooling, and systems/ops tools.

## Projects

- **BinaryInspector** — safe, local Rust CLI for inspecting ELF binaries without executing them. https://bisu.com.np/projects/binary-inspector (source: https://github.com/bisug/BinaryInspector)
- **Paila** — travel and community platform bridging tourists and local communities in Nepal. https://bisu.com.np/projects/paila (live: https://paila-prototype.vercel.app · source: https://github.com/bisug/Paila)
- **TG-GithubBot** — GitHub webhook handler bot for Telegram that formats push, deployment, and other events. https://bisu.com.np/projects/tg-github-bot (live: https://t.me/DearGitNotifyBot · source: https://github.com/bisug/TG-GithubBot)
- **ninfo** — Linux system information CLI in Nim that returns a whole-system snapshot as JSON in a single call. https://bisu.com.np/projects/ninfo (source: https://github.com/bisug/ninfo)
- **TG-WordGame** — Wordle-style word game bot for Telegram with solo and multiplayer rounds, daily challenge, and leaderboards. https://bisu.com.np/projects/tg-word-game (source: https://github.com/bisug/TG-WordGame)
- **Melody** — Telegram group-call streaming bot written in Python with Pyrogram. https://bisu.com.np/projects/melody (source: https://github.com/bisug/Melody)
- **heroku-buildpack-bun** — unofficial Heroku buildpack for Bun. https://bisu.com.np/projects/heroku-buildpack-bun (source: https://github.com/bisug/heroku-buildpack-bun)
- **SnakeGame-CLI** — cross-platform Snake game that runs entirely in the terminal. https://bisu.com.np/projects/snake-game-cli (source: https://github.com/bisug/SnakeGame-CLI)

Also on GitHub: https://github.com/bisug

## Hackathons

- **Build Nepal Hackathon** (1–2 August 2026, Mid Valley International College, Gyaneshwor, Kathmandu; organized by Mid-Valley International College): team Bugger built **NetGuard**, an explainable intrusion detection and prevention platform for small organizations. Status: participant.
- **JunctionX Kathmandu** (29–31 May 2026, AITM College, Khumaltar Height, Lalitpur; organized by SUMS Nepal & Cogknit): team Runtime Terrors built **Paila**, a travel and community platform connecting tourists with local communities in Nepal. Status: participant. https://junctionxkathmandu.com/past-events/2026
